button.purpose: Every pill label; Barlow Semi Condensed 600 in sentence case.

link-label.purpose: Text links; Barlow Semi Condensed 600 1.15rem in sentence case, 44px touch area.

numeral.purpose: Steps counters in Sage Deep on paper.

shadows.name: paper-lift

shadows.name: hero-photo
shadows.purpose: Box-shadow on the hero portrait img (no filter).

shadows.name: portrait
shadows.purpose: Box-shadow on portrait imgs on paper; the procedure strip has none.

shadows.name: button-lift
shadows.purpose: Primary pill at rest; hover deepens to 0 16px 28px -12px rgba(23,44,84,0.7) with the same inset.

shadows.name: rail-drop
shadows.purpose: Sticky rail; the action bar mirrors it as 0 -10px 24px -14px.

shadows.name: skip-link
shadows.purpose: The white skip pill while focused.

shadows.name: curtain-edge
shadows.purpose: Gathered inner edge of the left curtain half; mirrored (-14px) on the right.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The only easing; used for transforms, shadows and the curtain.

motion.name: curtain-open
motion.value: 1.5s ease-out 0.35s both; translateX(0) to translateX(±92%) desktop, ±100% below 900px
motion.purpose: Hero curtain halves parting on load; removed under prefers-reduced-motion (halves rendered open).

motion.name: hero-in
motion.value: 1s ease-out 1s both; opacity 0 to 1, translateY(14px) to none
motion.purpose: Hero content arrives after the curtain; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: state-transition
motion.value: transform 0.25s ease-out, background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s, border-color 0.2s, box-shadow 0.25s ease-out
motion.purpose: Button, text-link and nav-ring state changes.

motion.name: focus-ring
motion.value: outline 3px solid #2b5da8, offset 3px, radius 2px; #ffffff inside the rail, action bar and footer

motion.name: skip-reveal
motion.purpose: The skip link slides into view when focused.

breakpoints.name: wide
breakpoints.purpose: Conditions and techniques fall to two columns.

breakpoints.name: tablet
breakpoints.purpose: Rows, steps and duo go single column; nav wraps onto a second row; hero stacks; curtain exits fully; mobile action bar appears.

breakpoints.name: phone
breakpoints.purpose: Conditions, techniques and contact grid single column; buttons may wrap; evidence strip 4/3; epigraph gains side padding.

textures.name: curtain-ground
textures.purpose: Body background over #9db09a, scrolling with the page (not fixed); dark alphas capped at 0.07/0.03/0.02/0.03 so ink on the worst fold stays at 4.75:1.

textures.name: curtain-halves
textures.purpose: The parting halves over #7f9480 (--p: 34px), masked to transparent over the bottom 20%; they hold no text, so the heavier alphas are allowed.

textures.name: perforation
textures.purpose: 14px strip at the top of every sheet and slip.

pages.index: Home (hero with portrait, argument sheet, epigraph, first-visit steps with evidence photo, teaser duo, closing band)
pages.terapie: Terapie (Dalla visita alla cura, conditions with glosses, Farmaci e infiltrazioni, Altre terapie, ozone slip)
pages.contatti: Contatti e sedi (four-cell booking grid, Le sedi rows, online bay, first-visit checklist, emergency band)
pages.404: Pagina non trovata: page head with two pills, no nav item current
pages.navState: Each page marks its own rail item aria-current=page; footer nav never marked; 404 marks none
pages.bookingExits: MioDottore profile, tel:/wa.me for 379 208 2755, email, own pages; maps and practice sites on contatti only

meta.note: Site URL is the GitHub Pages address; update canonical, og:url, og:image, sitemap and robots when a custom domain is set.

extensions.retiredSteel: steel-light, steel-dark and steel-edge removed from the system; --steel remains only for nav rings and scrollbar thumb.
accessibility: Text on the sage curtain is Ink #1f2b23 (6.4:1 on #9db09a); white text is confined to the dark fitting #2f3f34 (11.2:1).
Scrub blue is reserved for actions, so colour alone never carries meaning elsewhere.
Global :focus-visible ring 3px #2b5da8 at 3px offset; white inside the rail, action bar and footer.
Mobile nav wraps onto two rows instead of scrolling; no content is hidden behind a mask.
Skip link "Vai al contenuto" is the first focusable element; main#contenuto is its target.
Curtain texture keeps ink at 4.75:1 or better on the darkest fold (Ground Contrast Rule).
Minimum targets: pills 54px, small pill, nav, text links, inline links and footer links 44px, action bar 50–52px.
External links carry the ext icon plus visually hidden '(si apre in una nuova pagina)' where needed.
prefers-reduced-motion removes the curtain and hero animations and renders the curtain open.
Emergency notice band carries no buttons; opening hours are never invented (agenda link only).
Content readable without JavaScript; images carry descriptive Italian alt text.

Perché rivolgersi a uno specialista del dolore

Un dolore che dura, o che non cede ai farmaci di base, non va sopportato in silenzio: è un sintomo, e come tale va capito.

narrative.overview:
The site is the pain therapist's treatment room, built from its three materials. A pleated hospital curtain in soft sage is the ground of every page: it never gives way to a white canvas, its vertical pleats run behind everything that is not paper, and text sits on it in ink, dark on light, as on a chart pinned to the fabric. Reading happens on paper-white sheets torn off the examination bed's roll, each with a perforated top edge, laid over the curtain one after another down the page. Scrub blue appears only where the visitor acts (book, call, write, open a map); it is never a heading, a rule, or an ornament. A solid dark-green rail runs across the top of the room and carries the navigation on small rings; the footer and the phone's action bar are the same dark fitting. The homepage is a slim front door (the portrait and the hook, the argument, one quotation, the first visit in three steps, two teasers, the booking band) and the four-page site is read through it.

The register is serious, plain and reassuring. Type is a condensed signage system (Barlow Condensed caps for labels and navigation, Barlow Semi Condensed for the hook, headings, buttons and link labels) set against a wide, quiet reading face (Source Sans 3) at a large body size, because the readers are often in pain, older, and on a phone in the evening. Density is low: one argument per bay, generous paper margins, 66-character measures, and one quotation given its own quiet band on the curtain. Motion is a single theatrical gesture, the curtain halves parting on load, and nothing else moves except a button lifting a pixel and an arrow sliding three.

The world rejects the medical-site default of a white page, a smiling-doctor hero, a blue accent everywhere and three icon cards. Photographs are the client-approved pictures of the doctor at work, set directly on the curtain or on paper as plain prints with a soft box-shadow, never as stock or background imagery.
keyCharacteristics: Sage curtain (`#9db09a`) is the page ground on every surface, read in ink (`#1f2b23`); paper sheets (`#f7f5f0`) carry all running copy.
The dark green (`#2f3f34`) is a fitting, not a ground: rail, footer and mobile action bar, always with white text, solid with no metallic trim.
Scrub blue (`#2b5da8`) is reserved for actions and inline links; it appears nowhere decorative.

Three self-hosted faces with a clear division of labour: Barlow Condensed caps for signage and navigation, Barlow Semi Condensed for headings, pill buttons and link labels in sentence case, Source Sans 3 for reading.
Paper edges are perforated (sage dots on a 14px pitch) wherever paper meets curtain.
Depth is physical but light: one long soft shadow under lifted paper, a box-shadow under photographs, a blue-tinted lift under the primary pill, a short drop under the rail, none under text.
Every control is at least 44px tall; call, WhatsApp and booking are always one tap away.
One choreographed motion (the curtain opening), fully disabled under `prefers-reduced-motion`.

rules.name: The Scrub Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means "act". It appears on primary buttons, inline links and the focus ring, and nowhere else: never on headings, rules, icons at rest, or backgrounds.

rules.name: The Paper for Reading Rule
rules.body: Running copy longer than one lead sentence lives on paper (`#f7f5f0`) with ink (`#1f2b23`). A green bay holds a heading, one or two lead sentences and an action; anything longer is laid on a paper slip. The epigraph is the one exception: a single quotation may stand on the curtain.

rules.name: The Ink on Sage Rule
rules.body: Text on the curtain is Ink, never white: the sage is light enough to be read like paper. White text exists only on the dark fittings (Rail), and nothing in the sage family is used as a surface for white text.

rules.name: The Ground Contrast Rule
rules.body: Ink on the darkest point of the curtain texture must stay at or above 4.5:1; as built the worst case, ink on a fold, is 4.75:1. The fold shadows are therefore lightened to alphas of 0.07, 0.03, 0.02 and 0.03 (the broad pleat, the secondary fold, the slow drift, the vertical wash). A new ground layer may not darken beyond that, and the lighter pleat highlights may be strengthened instead.

rules.name: The Signage Caps Rule
rules.body: Barlow Condensed is always uppercase and tracked (0.06–0.1em) and is never used for running text, buttons or link labels; Source Sans 3 is never uppercase or tracked. Buttons and text links are Barlow Semi Condensed in sentence case, the same face as the headings.

rules.name: The One Hook Rule
rules.body: Display size exists once per page, for the hero hook on the homepage or the page title on an inner page; sections open with Headline and never with a label above the heading.

rules.name: The Lifted Paper Rule
rules.body: Only things that physically sit on the curtain cast a shadow: paper, photographs and the blue pill. Nothing on paper casts a shadow onto paper; hierarchy inside a sheet is done with rules, type and whitespace.

rules.name: The Scrolling Curtain Rule
rules.body: The curtain texture scrolls with the page and carries no `background-attachment: fixed`; the pleat pitch stays 72px over Sage so a new ground surface continues the same fabric.

dos: **Do** keep the sage curtain as the ground of every page and let it show between sheets; a new page starts from `#9db09a` with the four light pleat layers, never from white.
**Do** keep ink on every part of the curtain at 4.5:1 or better: fold shadows stay at or under the alphas listed in the Ground Contrast Rule.
**Do** set text on the curtain in Ink (`#1f2b23`), and reserve white text for the dark fittings (`#2f3f34`: rail, footer, action bar).
**Do** put any copy longer than one or two lead sentences on paper (a sheet or a slip) in Ink; keep green bays to heading, lead and action.
**Do** give every paper edge that meets the curtain the 14px perforation strip of Sage dots.
**Do** use Scrub Blue only for primary pills, inline links and the focus ring; keep ghost pills Ink-stroked (White only inside the action bar).
**Do** build buttons as 54px pills in Barlow Semi Condensed sentence case with the icon in a tinted circle (bare glyph for WhatsApp), and text links in the same face with the drawn underline.
**Do** keep every touch target at 44px or more (54px pills, 44px small pill, nav, links and footer links, 50–52px in the action bar) and keep the fixed action bar on every content page below 900px.
**Do** use one number, 379 208 2755, for both call and WhatsApp, and point every booking action at MioDottore, the phone, WhatsApp, email or the site's own pages.
**Do** open every inner page with a page head directly on the curtain and close it with a green band; let the emergency notice band stand without buttons.

**Do** use definition rows for lists of treatments, credentials and practices, condition groups with plain-language glosses for jargon, and the unified terms "Farmaci e infiltrazioni" and "Altre terapie".
**Do** write h2 headings without a trailing full stop (the hero hook keeps its own).
**Do** mark external links with the `#i-ext` icon, `target="_blank"` and visually hidden text.
**Do** keep the skip link as the first focusable element and `main#contenuto` as its target.
**Do** honour `prefers-reduced-motion` by removing both hero animations and rendering the curtain open.
donts: **Don't** use Scrub Blue, or any other saturated colour, for headings, rules, icons at rest or backgrounds.
**Don't** put white text on any sage (`#9db09a`, `#7f9480`) or use the dark green as a page ground.
**Don't** fix the curtain texture to the viewport or darken it beyond the Ground Contrast Rule.
**Don't** reintroduce metallic trim: the rail and action bar are solid Rail green with at most a 1px translucent line.
**Don't** put shadows under elements that sit on paper, or under text; only paper, photographs and the blue pill cast shadows, and photographs use box-shadow, not filters.
**Don't** set buttons or text links in uppercase or in Barlow Condensed; signage caps are for labels and navigation.
**Don't** put a disc behind the WhatsApp glyph in a pill, or a button beside the emergency notice.
**Don't** add a second accent, a kicker above headings, or a display-size setting outside the hero hook and the inner-page title.
**Don't** make the homepage a long brochure: it points to the inner pages with steps, text links and teasers rather than repeating their content.
**Don't** invent opening hours or claim mechanisms or comparisons for a therapy; copy stays descriptive and points to the visit and the MioDottore agenda.
**Don't** use stock photography, decorative anatomy, or icon cards; the only images are the client-approved photographs with their provenance sidecars.
**Don't** round corners beyond 4px except on pills, the 14px action-bar tile and circles (button icon discs, nav rings).
**Don't** treat the footer's amber privacy tag as a pattern; it exists to be deleted.
